**Position:** Postdoctoral Researcher at Sciences Po

I am a political economist interested in central banks. My PhD thesis delt with the variegated integration of climate concerns within central banks. My current research investigates the ideational struggles within central bank committees, the reputation management strategies of central banks, and the formal and informal interaction between central bankers and politicians. I use mixed methods, combining semi-structured interviews, textual data, natural language processing techniques and econometrics.
